description: Count of the declared account's orders (class Orders) on the store, all or of one status; min/max bound all its orders, minOrdersInStatus the status. Output orderCount (of the status when given, else all). Read only. KB: Order History.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the account that owns the orders: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username. Left out (verification only): any owner

orderStatus.description: Order status code, normalised (ZnodeOmsOrderState.StatusCode), e.g. submitted, canceled, shipped, failed. Left out: all orders

minOrders.description: Orders (any status) the account must own on the store (at least)

maxOrders.description: Most orders allowed, e.g. the page size so all fit one page. Left out: no upper bound

minOrdersInStatus.description: Orders in orderStatus the account must own (at least). Left out: no status count check

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
